calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for oda.com
calls.summary: The meeting detailed Oda's current use of GrowthBook, highlighting its integration for A/B testing and feature flagging across various teams, including a shop team of about 25 people. Currently, around 50 users have access, with plans to optimize this to 30-40 for effective management. Budget constraints were discussed, with Oda aiming for an annual expenditure of about $2,400 for 10 seats. Technical considerations included the handling of multiple Kubernetes clusters and shared state management in MongoDB. Oda serves approximately 70,000 weekly users in Norway and 40,000-50,000 in Sweden, capturing around 4% of the grocery market, and expressed an interest in collaboration for case studies to enhance visibility.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, self-hosting, A/B testing, enterprise pricing, feature flagging, Kubernetes
